response.justification: The candidate is a strong generalist engineer with deep experience in TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web platforms, but does not meet the core requirements of this role. Professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 (plus a thesis project), far short of the mandated 5–10 years on Windows. There is no capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domain exposure (RIDE Capital is a startup investment-administration platform, not capital markets), and no SQL Server/Oracle experience is evidenced.
strengths: Solid engineering fundamentals with TDD, CI/CD, and systems-level low-latency experience (DLang, async I/O)
Broad, adaptable technology background across backend, web, and embedded systems
Strong communication skills demonstrated through workshops, talks, and open-source leadership
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, roughly a decade ago, not Windows-platform focused
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; recent stack is entirely different (TypeScript/Node/MongoDB)

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain background
Strong general engineering and communication skills
